High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Tempest Scout 3 (V)]] (Virtual Set 2, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 2/Set 2 Dark/Tempest Scout 3.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeSEtHUnFzOHoySmc/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Tempest Scout 3.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,343,836 bytes, SHA-256 <code>34be9f3837b83bfd1a4bf9356b12eefd32e0c8f716e262d0664cb492b23321f4</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V2-D-tempestscout3-2018-07-08.gif]].
